items.author: MylesGinvest
items.context: @MylesGinvest (38.411 seguidores), en inglés: «Bitcoin pumped 17% from the bottom in a couple days there will be a pullback. Any strong fast move will retrace. The bottom is in. Higher soon» (con imagen). Post de ~80 min que está despegando (87 likes, 3.102 vistas) con solo 11 respuestas: cuenta mediana, afirmación cuestionable sobre el piso. Ángulo: caídas y ciclos (Drawdown Atlas) + temperatura y media de 200 semanas.
items.suggested_text:
A 17% bounce off a capitulation low is normal, and so is the retrace after it. The harder part is that cycle bottoms rarely show up as a single wick. Even the recoveries don't rhyme: 2013 had two separate tops, one reclaimed in 210 days, the other in 1,177. Same asset, same year, very different paths.

What I watch is whether valuation and time agree with price. The market temperature index I track (MVRV, price vs the 200-week average, drawdown from the high, volatility-adjusted momentum) went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days. That's about as cold as it reads, but cold isn't the same as turned.

Price is also still under the 200-week average. How it behaves on the first real test of that line probably says more than the 17% did.
